اندمجت (form VII)
# اِنْدَمَجْتُ (indamajtu) /in.da.mad͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْدَمَجَ (indamaja)
# اِنْدَمَجْتَ (indamajta) /in.da.mad͡ʒ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْدَمَجَ (indamaja)
# اِنْدَمَجْتِ (indamajti) /in.da.mad͡ʒ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْدَمَجَ (indamaja)
# اِنْدَمَجَتْ (indamajat) /in.da.ma.d͡ʒat/: thir
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
